title: Cheap & brittle
text: Cheap & brittle. The first time using when I went to dump the ice out the plastic around the silicone cracked and broke. These are cheap and brittle and I do not recommend.

product_metadata.title: Ice Cube Trays, 3 Pack Ice Trays, Easy-Release Silicone & Flexible 21 Ice Cube Trays with Spill-Resistant Removable Lid, BPA Free, for Home Party Guests Serving Whiskey, Cocktails
features: 100% Safe Material--This ice cube trays consists of food-grade silicone tray and PP lid, BPA-free, safe and reusable, rest assured to use it for adult/baby food. 3-pack ice cube trays create 63 ice balls at a time.
Durable & Quality--High-toughness silicone ice cube trays are unlikely to crack or break like stiff plastic trays after freezing. Resistance to low/high temp (-4℉~212℉), safe in dishwasher.

Easy to Release--Flexible, non-stick silicone tray makes it easy to slide out ice balls with perfect shape. You’d better leave it alone for a while after taking it out from freezer, then push from the bottom.

Stackable & Hygienic--Each ice cube maker has a removable lid, which designed to block odors and dust, prevent leakage, also makes 3 packs ice ball trays can be stacked neatly in the freezer to save space.
Widely Use--Fill with mint, fruit, yogurt, or juice to create ice cream, popsicles, baby food or jelly. Also make pure ice balls to chill your whisky, cocktail. Enjoy cool summer with cool ice trays.
